title: RPG Maker MV Engine Black Screen

posts.author: Alz
posts.body:
As the title suggests, the engine screen is black when I open it. So far, I've tried opening a different project, restarting my computer, reinstalling the engine, deleting the files from the /Local/ folder and using an older version, but nothing worked.
Thing is, the buttons seem to still be functional, as I managed to make a new project, so it must be some visual/display problem. Figured it had something to do with the drivers, but I'm not knowledgeable in that field and no browser searches led to solutions.
If it helps with anything, my display adapters are AMD Radeon and RTX 2050, and I haven't messed with anything besides the occasional NVIDIA Driver and Windows 11 Update.

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
if you have two display chips, then there is a windows system telling each program which chip to use as primary. And there have been a lot of cases with display errors if the wrong chip was selected.
so search for that option and switchit to the other chip for testing.
another question: do you also have two displays/monitors? If yes, make sure both the editor and the game remain on the primary monitor.
as for the drivers - can you check if the driver manufacturer is AMD/nVidia or Microsoft? Microsoft has some drivers for both that are not fully OpenGL compatible (because OpenGL is competition to Microsoft's DirectX) and those can cause problems.

posts.author: Alz
posts.body: Solved! Reseting the game profile settings to default in the AMD Software did the trick.
